༄༅/ /'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes lha lnga rga lo lugs kyi sgrub thabs don gnyis kyi 'dod 'jo bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes lha lnga rga lo lugs kyi sgrub thabs don gnyis kyi 'dod 'jo bzhugs so//

bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes lha lnga rga lo lugs kyi sgrub thabs don gnyis kyi 'dod pa 'jo ba zhes bya ba| bla ma dang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// spros bral zab zhi 'dus ma byas pa'i dbyings// mi 'gyur sna tshogs sgyu ma'i gar mkhan des// thabs shes 'khor 'das gzung 'dzin dra ba'i chos// don dam gcig tu sdom mdzad des bdag srungs// nyams su blang ba'i sdom ni/ bdud rtsi myang dang gtor ma gtang*// mchod pa byin brlab skyabs sems dang*// sgo gsum dag pa tshangs gnas bzhi// phung khams byin brlab srung 'khor bsgom// tshogs bsag rten dang brten pa bskyed// gnas gsum byin brlab go cha bgo// ye shes bstim la dbang bskur dang*// rgyas gdab mchod bstod dag pa dran// bde chen nyams myong bzlas pa bya// thun bsdu gtor 'bul spyod lam 'jug /dang po ni/ dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i sngags pas/ ri bo'am/ nags tshal lam/ dur khrod dam/ rgyud nas gsungs pa'i gnas su bris sku mchod gtor nang mchod cang te'u/ rang gi mdun du rdor dril/ g.yas su cang te'u/ g.yon du nang mchod/ rdor dril la sogs nyer mkho rnams ma tshang ba med par 'du bya/ stan bde bar thor tshugs sogs rgyan dang ldan pas/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das lhan cig skyes pa'i skur gsal bar gyur/ nang mchod/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang gi dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu/ shar du oṃ las dri chen/ byang du khaṃ las klad pa/ nub tu aṃ las byang sems/ lhor trāṃ las rak+ta/ slar yang dbus su bāṃ las mi'i sha/

shar lhor māṃ las ba glang gi sha/ lho nub tu lāṃ las khyi'i sha/ nub byang du pāṃ las rta'i sha/ byang shar du sa bon sha rnams go log pa ltar snang yang bu ston bzhed pa ltar byas/ tāṃ las glang po'i sha rnams sa bon de rnams kyis mtshan pa/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis rlung g.yos me sbar zhing bskol bas rdzas sa bon dang bcas pa zhu ba dmar ser du snang ba'i rlangs pa las byung ba'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po mgo thur bstan du snang ba yang zhu zhing 'dres pa'i steng du/ ā li kā li las byung ba'i oṃ āḥhūm̐ brtsegs mar gnas pa las sku gsung thugs kyi lha rnams spros/ 'gro ba'i don byas nas snyoms par zhugs pa yi ge gsum la thim zhing de yang zhu ba bdud rtsi la 'dres pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod la/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin sbyar bas myangs/ gnyis pa/ gtor mar bran pa/ bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs gong ltar byas la/ pad kor rdor thal kha phye ba'i rgyas/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rāk+ṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsā/ un+mā da/ a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya dā ya i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya the baṃ/ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ pi ba tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kārta ya sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dha ya sa hā yi kaṃ bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ spro na/ lha yi tshogs nas/ kun grub mdzod kyi bar yang bya/ gsum pa/ mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūm̐ las rdo rje'i mchod yon/ zhal bsil/ bsang gtor/ zhabs bsil| me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa rang bzhin stong pa/ rnam pa mchod rdzas/ byed las dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma thams cad dgyes pa bskyed nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/

oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ ā tsa mā naṃ= prok+ṣa ṇaṃ= pā d+yaṃ= puṣ+pe= dhū pe= ā lo ke= gan+dhe= nai wi d+ye= shapad= zhes sbyar/ bzhi pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can// dpa' bo dang ni dpa' mo'i tshogs// kun la bdag ni skyabs su mchi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag ni he ru kar gyur nas// sems can thams cad he ru ka'i// go 'phang mchog la 'god par bgyi// lan gsum/ lnga pa ni/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te// he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid// ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste// ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o// zhes don dran pas yid dag pa/ shrī he ru ko3haṃ/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das sku mdog mthing ga /zhal gcig /phyag gnyis/ rdor dril 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ g.yas brkyang gis gnas par gyur/ ces mos pas lus dag pa/ oṃ a ā/ sogs/ ha k+ṣaḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum brjod cing*/ rang gi lte bar yi ge'i phreng ba g.yon skor rim pa gsum du gnas pa 'od 'bar ba las 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs spros pas/ bgegs thams cad bskrad cing bcom nas/ slar yang sngags phreng la thim par gyur par bsam pa ni ngag dag pa'o// drug pa ni/ gzhan phan bsam pa byams pa ste// snying rjes gzhan gyi sdug bsngal 'joms// gzhan bdes tshim pa dga' ba ste// sems can gzhan snyoms btang snyoms so// zhes don dran pas lan gsum/ bdun pa ni/ rang gi phung khams skye mched rnams don dam par rang bzhin stong pa nyid la kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu/ mgo bor gzugs phung la buṃ las rnam snang dkar po/ g.yas 'khor lo gdengs shing*/ g.yon snyems pa dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ lte bar tshor phung la aṃ las rdo rje nyi ma ser po/

mgrin par 'du shes kyi phung po hrīḥlas pad+ma gar dbang dmar po/ rkang pa'i long bu gnyis kyi 'og tu 'du byed kyi phung por hoḥlas rdo rje rgyal po ljang gu rnams g.yas rin po che dang*/ pad+ma dmar po dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje gdengs shing*/ g.yon rol pa dang bcas pas dril bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ snying gar rnam shes kyi phung por hūm̐ las rdor sems dkar po/ g.yas 'gyings pa dang bcas pas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon snyems pa dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ spyi gtsug tu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gcig pa nyid phung po lnga'i de bzhin nyid hi las dpal he ru ka nag po/ g.yas sa gnon gyi phyag rgyas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ mig gnyis ni oṃ las gti mug rdo rje dkar po/ g.yas 'khor lo 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon dril bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rna ba gnyis ni hūm̐ las zhe sdang rdo rje nag po/ g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon snyems pa dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ sna bug gnyis ni trāṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ser po/ lce ni aṃ las 'dod chags rdo rje dmar po/ dpral ba ni lus te khaṃ las ser sna rdo rje ljang gu rnams g.yas rin po che dang*/ pad+ma dmar po dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje gdengs shing*/ g.yon rol pa dang bcas pas dril bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ yid ni snying gar haṃ las dbang phyug rdo rje dkar po/ g.yas rdo rje 'dzin cing g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ lte bar lāṃ las sa khams la ltung byed ma ser mo/ g.yas dang pos 'khor lo/ snying gar māṃ las chu khams la gsod byed ma nag mo/ g.yas dang pos rdo rje/ mgrin par pāṃ las me khams la 'gugs byed ma dmar mo/ g.yas dang pos pad+ma/ dpral bar tāṃ las rlung khams la pad+ma gar dbang ljang gu/ g.yas dang pos ral gri/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig /phyag bzhi las g.yas 'og ma gri gug /g.yon dang po thod pa/

'og ma kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ gsang gnas su khaṃ las nam mkha'i khams la pad+ma dra ba can ma sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dud kha/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ phyag g.yas gsum gri gug /tshangs mgo/ lcags kyu/ g.yon gsum thod pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ/ zhags pa bsnams pa/ rnam snang la sogs pa rnams g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ ral pa'i cod pan can spyan gsum pa phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ lha mo rnams gcer bu skra grol zhing g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis/ lha rnams rang rang gi 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa/ oṃ pra kṛta pa ri shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥpra kṛta pa ri shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pad kor 'khyud tshul dang bcas pas rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i nga rgyal bzung*/ brgyad pa ni/ g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis se gol rim pa bzhin phyogs rnams su gtog cing*/ shar du oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa nag po/ byang du oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ljang gu/ nub tu oṃ gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa dmar po/ lhor oṃ ā na ya hoḥ bha ga wān badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ser po rnams 'od zer 'bar ba tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi la thug par khyab pa/ 'og tu hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa phyogs kyi mdog can gyi rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur oṃ me dī ni badz+rī bha wa badz+ra ban+dha hūm̐/ de rnams kyi 'od zer dang kha dog las grub pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i ra ba gru bzhi pa oṃ badz+ra pra kā ra hūm̐ paṃ hūm̐/ ra ba'i steng du rdo rje'i gur oṃ badz+ra pañdza ra hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐/ ra gur gyi mtshams su rdo rje'i bla bre oṃ badz+ra bi tā na hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐/ gur gyi steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa lta bu'i mde'u can gyi mda'i dra ba oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la traṃ saṃ traṃ/ phyi rol tu rdo rje'i me bskal pa 'jig pa'i me phung lta bur bar med du khyab par gyur oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/

zhes thun mong gi srung 'khor bsgom/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bsrung 'khor bsgom par 'dod na sngar ltar se gol dang bcas/ oṃ suṃ bha ni nas tsakra pra kā ra hūm̐/ zhes pa'i bar gzhan ltar bsgom/ dgu pa ni/ srung 'khor gyi dbus su rang he ru kar gsal ba'i snying gar paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ sngon po las 'od zer sna tshogs phyogs bcur spros pas/ bla ma dang dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par bsam/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo// rnal 'byor gnas la bdag phyag 'tshal// zhes yid kyis phyag bya/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ shapada'i bar chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo dang*/ oṃ badz+ra wī ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra waṃ she huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mṛ taṃ ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mu rañdze huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra hā s+ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gī ti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dī pe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ oṃ rū pa badz+ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ra sa badz+ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ spar+she badz+ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces so so'i sngags rgya dang bcas pa phyi mchod/ slar yang snying ga'i hūm̐ las mkha' 'gro ma sogs bzhi spros pas/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa thogs nas mchod par gyur/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes thigs gtor 'bul ba nang mchod/ lha mo de rnams yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la thim zhing yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas de'i bde bas lha thams cad mnyes par gyur/

oṃ shrī ma hā su kha he he ru ru kaṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa| ces 'khyud tshul bya ba gsang mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*| |sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don gyi rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ yi ge brgya pa ci 'grub bzla/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur pa ni bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// rang gi dpral mgrin snying gar he ru ka zhes pa'i yi ge dkar dmar sngo ba/ he ni chos thams cad rgyu dang bral ba/ ru ni tshogs pa dang bral ba/ ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o// de ltar chos thams cad skye ba med par bdag dang bdag gir bzung bas 'khor bar gyur to// de bas bdag he ru kar gyur nas sems can thams cad kyis kyang chos thams cad tshul ji lta ba khong du chud par bgyi'o// zhes chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje bskyed nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid gzung 'dzin gyis stong pa/ sems tsam gyi rang bzhin de yang sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis oṃ āḥhūm̐ dkar dmar sngon po steng nas steng du brtsegs pa las sku gsung thugs kyi lha rnams spros/ sems can thams cad 'khor lo gsum gyi lhar byas nas snyoms par zhugs pas byang sems su zhu ba yi ge gsum la thim zhing*/ de yang oṃ āḥl/ āḥhūm̐ la/ hūm̐ zhabs kyu/ khog pa/ mgo bo/ zla tshes/ thig le/ nā da'i bar du bsdus nas/ nā da yang skra'i rtse mo brgya stong gi cha tsam du gyur/

sems can thams cad chos nyid khong du ma chud pas 'khor bar gyur gyi/ bdag gis chos nyid rtogs pas byang chub mngon du byas te/ sems can thams cad kyang de ltar bgyi'o// zhes dmigs med kyi snying rje bskyed nas/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ nā da de yang mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur par bsam pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs so// bcu pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las slar yang rang gi sems nā da'i rnam pa shin tu phra ba dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can nam mkhar gnas pa de'i 'od kyis e las chos 'byung dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ yaṃ las rlung dkyil sngon po gzhu lta bu rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis spras pa'i steng du/ raṃ las me dkyil dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa'i steng du/ baṃ las chu dkyil dkar zlum bum pas brgyan pa'i steng du/ laṃ las sa dkyil ser po gru bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'i steng du/ suṃ las ri rab rin chen sna bzhi las grub pa gru bzhi pa'i rtse mo lcog brgyad kyis mdzes pa'i steng du/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma ge sar dang ldan pa'i steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs kyi mdog can gyi lte bar/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma phyogs bzhi dmar zhing*| ge sar dang me rlung ser po/ lte ba dang bden bral ljang gu/ dbang ldan nag po'i mdog can du gyur par bsam pa ni rten gyi gzhi bskyed pa'o// pad+ma'i lte bar mtshan so gnyis kyi ngo bo/ a ā/ sogs/ aṃ aḥ phrag gnyis las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar po la ā di bcu drug dkar po phrag gnyis g.yas g.yon du bskor ba me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi steng du/ dpe byad brgyad cu'i ngo bo ka kha ga gha nga*/ sogs/ ha k+ṣaḥ ḍa ḍha da dha ya la phrag gnyis las zla ba dmar po la kā di bzhi bcu pa phrag gnyis g.yas g.yon du bskor ba mnyam nyid ye shes bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor ro// rang sems nam mkha'i nā das de dag mthong bas bdag gis sangs rgyas yab yum byang sems dkar dmar gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i zla ba dkar dmar gyi bar du zhugs nas he ru kar langs te/

sems can gyi don bya'o snyam pas zla ba'i bar du zhugs ma thag nā da las thig le ū yig gi bar hūm̐ yig dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can du grub pa rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba sor rtog ye shes/ de las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs spros te sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyangs 'khor lo sdom pa'i lhar byas/ thog ma med pa nas grub pa'i phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams dang lhan cig spyan drangs te thabs shes snyoms par zhugs pas byang sems su zhu ba hūm̐ gi nā da la thim pa bya grub ye shes te rjes su rnal 'byor ro// zla ba dbyangs gsal hūm̐ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa skad cig gis rdzogs pa chos dbyings ye shes so// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi bdag nyid can nga'o snyam du bsam/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥbadz+ra shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pas chos thams cad thabs shes dbyer med rdo rje'i rang bzhin du dag la bdag kyang de'i rang bzhin du dag pa'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal gzung*| rdo rje'i ra gur 'jig dus kyi me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i me ri dang bcas pa gsal ba'i phyi rol du shar nas g.yon skor du/ gtum drag /tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ rdo rje 'bar ba/ keng rus can/ dbang ldan nas g.yas skor du mi bzad bzhad pa/ bkra shis tshal/ mun pa drag po/ ki li ki la sgrog pa ste dur khrod chen po brgyad/ chu brgyad kyis yongs su phye ba'i chu la klu chen brgyad gnas pa/ shing brgyad kyi rtsa bar phyogs skyong brgyad dang*/ rtse mor zhing skyong brgyad/ steng du sprin brgyad kyi gseb tu lus stod thon pa'i lha brgyad/

ri brgyad la gnas pa'i mchod rten brgyad/ grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa brgyad/ me brgyad/ bya rgod dang ce spyang sogs drag cing 'jigs pa sna tshogs pa'i gdong can dang*/ sbrul ba lang gi mgo can sogs rgyu zhing*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po/ ro langs la sogs pa gar byed pa/ ro mdung gis phug pa dang*/ shing las 'phyang ba dang*/ 'thor ba dang*/ tshig pa dang*/ brtsigs pa la sogs pa rus pa'i tshogs dang*/ rig 'dzin dang grub pa dam tshig spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo la sogs pa rgyu zhing*/ mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa'i bkod pa dang ldan pa/ srung 'khor gyi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar rin po che'i sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang nang nas rim bzhin nag /ljang*| dmar/ ser/ dkar ba'i rtsig pa lnga ldan/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ grwa bzhi dang sgo 'khyud kyi mtshams su zla phyed rin po che rdo rjes spras pa/ rtsig pa'i steng du rin po che'i snam bu la rin po che sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ de'i steng du gser gyi ska rags bzhi la btags pa'i chu srin gyi kha nas 'phyangs pa'i rin po che'i dra ba dang*/ dra phyed/ g.yer kha'i phreng ba can gyi steng du| shar bu sngon po la ril ba mgo thur bstan lta bu'i pha gu can gyis bteg pa'i bya 'dab kyi steng du pad+ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyi mda' yab dang*/ steng du gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa la rin po che'i rgyan du mas mdzes pa bsgrengs pa/ sgo bzhi'i mdun du ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i steng du pad zlar gnas pa'i 'khor lo'i steng du gdugs dang*/ g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo gser mdog gi 'khor du spre'us bzung ba'i gdugs dkar dmar dang*/ rnga yab zla ba rlung gis skyod pa dang*/ dril bu g.yer kha 'og pag la sogs pa du ma 'phyang zhing sgra 'byin pa/ phyi 'gram du 'dod snam dmar pos bskor ba la lha mo du mas mchod rdzas thogs nas gar byed pa/

sgo'i g.yas g.yon du bum bzang las thon pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing la rgyal srid rin po che bdun la sogs pas brgyan pa/ nang rin po che'i ka ba brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rdo rje'i gdung gis phub pa'i thog gi rtse mor rdo rje nor bu rin po che'i tog 'bar bas mtshan pa/ gzhal yas khang gi nang gi steng 'og thams cad shar sngo/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser ba'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa mu khyud la gri gug gi phreng bas bskor ba'i ze'u 'brur nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ bcu gcig pa ni/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog nag po/ zhal gcig pa/ mche ba bzhi gtsigs shing zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ 'jigs su rung ba'i nyams can/ skra mtshams su rdo rje'i phreng bas sbrel ba'i thod skam lnga rin po che'i rtse bran gyis spras pa/ ral pa'i thor cog gi mdun du sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon du zla phyed rtse mor nor bu 'chang ba/ mi'i rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i mgo rlon khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang*| mi rus kyi 'khor lo/ rna cha/ mgul rgyan/ gdub kor/ ska rags te phyag rgya lnga dang thal chen gyis byugs pa/ mi'i skra las byas pa'i mchod phyir thogs pa dang stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod pan gyis mdzes pa/ zhabs g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po mgo bo bltabs pa'i rna ba g.yon dang*/ g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma'i bar du brdzis pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ dgod pa drag shul 'jigs su rung*/ snying rje rngam pa zhi ba ste/ gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa nyid/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba'i pang du/ yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig /spyan gsum skra grol ba/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can phyag rgya lngas spras pa/

nam mkha'i gos can gzhon zhing mdzes pa lang tsho dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yon bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud cing*/ g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thogs pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis gdug pa can thams cad sdigs pa/ zhabs g.yas kyi byin pas bcom ldan 'das la 'khyud cing g.yon brkyangs pa/ bde ba chen po'i nyams can bskal me ltar 'bar ba'i gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la zla ba dang ro'i gdan la/ mdun du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ g.yon du rab mdzes ma ljang gu/ rgyab tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ g.yas su gzugs can ma ser mo/ bzhi ga zhal gcig /spyan gsum/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang dum bu lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lngas spras pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug 'phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa'i gru mo kha ṭ+wāṃ gas mtshan pa/ skra sil bur grol ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskums pas gnas pa/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pa'i steng du sha lngas gang ba'i thod pa dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur/ de thams cad chos sku'i rang bzhin du shes pa'i phyir dag pa bsgom pa'o// lus rjes su dran pa nyer bzhag ni mkha' 'gro ma'o// tshor ba rjes su dran pa nyer bzhag ni rab mdzes ma'o/ */ chos rjes su dran pa nyer bzhag ni dum skyes ma'o// sems rjes su dran pa nyer bzhag ni gzugs can ma'o// yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka rdo rje'o// bcu gnyis pa ni/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma la āḥdamar po/ snying gar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ nag pos mtshan pa/ bcu gsum pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā hu dmar po/ phrag pa gnyis su bau ṣaṭa he nag po/ mig gnyis su huṃ hūm̐ hoḥdamar ser/

lus thams cad la phaṭa haṃ ljang gu/ bcom ldan 'das ma dang rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo/ khar hrīṃ moṃ dkar mo/ mgo bor hriṃ hrīṃ ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu huṃ hūm̐ ljang gu/ smin mtshams su phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams kyis mtshan par gyur par dmigs/ bcu bzhi pa ni/ lag pa'i mdzub mo gnyis mdud/ gung mo gnyis steng du rtse sprad/ mthe bong gnyis 'og tu rtse sbyar/ sor mo gzhan rnams brkyangs pa 'bar ba'i rgya dpral bar bzhag cing g.yon du bskor ba dang gdong bsgyur mig gyen du blta/ rkang pa g.yon pas g.yas mnan la/ pheṃ/ zhes pa'i sgra dang bcas/ snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rnams rang 'dra'i ye shes pa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las lha mo bcu drug spros nas mchod/ oṃ badz+ra wī ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nas/ dharma dhā tu'i bar gyi sngags rgyas mchod/ ye shes pa rnams yang dag par mnyes par bya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes phyag rgya bzhis ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ rnam lnga 'dod kor dang 'khyud pa'i rgyas/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ chos thams cad thabs shes dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor du dag la bdag kyang de'i ngo bor dag go// zhes nga rgyal bzung*/ bco lnga pa ni/ slar yang snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa dang gshegs ma/ byang chub sems dpa' dang sems ma/ khro bo dang khro mo ste gdan gsum tshang ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ shrī tsakra sam+ba raṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī badz+ra puṣ+pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ nai wi d+ya'i bar sbyar ba'i nyer spyod lngas mchod/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la/

/mchod chen ji ltar bstsal ba ltar// bdag kyang rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// ces gsol ba btab pas/ khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyis bgegs skrod/ sems ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ sems dpa' rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ gshegs ma rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa dkar po byang sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba cung zad yo bar bsnams te/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis// skye bas thob pa'i dbang bskur ba// ji ltar de bzhin bdag gis te// dag pa lha yi chu dbang bskur// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐| zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag yar lud pa las bcom ldan 'das la mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la rnam snang*/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsam/ bcu drug pa ni/ snying ga'i hūm̐ las spros pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas thogs pa nam mkha'i khams kun nas gang bas dkyil 'khor pa la mchod par gyur/ oṃ shrī tsakra sam+ba raṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ chu gzhan gsum nyer spyod rol mo dang*/ oṃ badz+ra wī ni sogs/ rig ma bcu drug gi mchod pa ni phyi'i 'o// nang mchod ni/ ka pā la'i bdud rtsi g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis thigs gtor dbul zhing*/ mchod do/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang dang klu sgrub dril bu pa// dzā lan+dha ra nag po spyod pa dang*// til+li pa dang nā ro kar+ṇa ri| |rdo rje gdan pa 'jigs med 'byung gnas zhabs// rtswa mi rga lo dpal ldan phag gru pa// 'jig rten gsum mgon spyan snga grags pa 'byung*// bcu gnyis pa dang dbang phyug bsod nams dang*// grags pa shes rab tshul rgyal grags rdor ba// 'dren mchog bla ma blo bzang rin bzang zhabs// bsod nams bkra shis rje btsun rat+na'i mtshan// rdo rje 'chang dbang chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs// dngos grub rtsa ba rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ aḥhūm̐/

oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ lā me oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ rū pi ṇī ye oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā tsa tur+hastāya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba dharma pā lā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rnams kyis mchod/ oṃ a mṛ ta swā da swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes bdud rtsi myangs/ gsang mchod ni/ yab kyi gsang ba'i hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa nor bu oṃ dang bu ga phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ yum gyi mkha' āḥlas pad dmar 'dab brgyad ze'u 'bru āḥdang rtsa hrīḥyig dmar pos mtshan pa/ yab yum phan tshun dga' ba brtsams shing snyoms par zhugs pas lha thams cad lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba chen po nyams su myong bar gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung la/ rang bzhin dag pa'i gnas goms nas// lha yi snying po sgom byed pa// de ni mchod pa chen por 'dod// sangs rgyas thams cad rtogs byed pa'o// zhes de kho nas mchod/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ swā hā/ oṃ hrī ha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ lā me huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rū pi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes lha so so'i sku la dmigs nas sngags kyis mchod/ bcu bdun pa ni/ rdor dril dang bcas/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bī re shā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā kalpāg+ni saṃ ni bha ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dzā ṭa ma ku ṭot+ka ṭā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ daṃ ṣ+ṭ+wā ka ra lo gra bhi ṣa ṇa mu khā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pa ra shu pā shod+yā ta shū la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dhā ri ṇe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ byā gh+rā dzi nāṃ wa ra dha rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā dhū mrān+dha kā ra wa pu ṣā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces yab kyi rkang brgyad dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa tī badz+ra wā rā hī baṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo ār+ya a pa rā dzi te trai lokya mā te ma hā bīd+ye shwa ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥsarba bhū ta bha yā wa he ma hā badz+re huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo badz+ra ā sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te wa sh+yaṃ ka ri ni tra bh+rā ma ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥsho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dha ni ka rā li ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥtrā sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni a pa rā dza ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzam+bha ni s+t+wam+bha ni mo ha ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo badz+ra wā rā hī ma hā yo gi nī kā me shwa ri kha ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes yum gyi rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ bco brgyad pa ni/ dpa' bo'i rtsa ba'i sngags sogs gang*// tshangs pa'i skud pa sogs su btags// dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi yis| |lus kyi khams la rtag pa'o// dpa' bo'i go cha drug po yi// phyag rgya 'dis ni lus mdzes so// rdo rje phag mo'i sngags gang yin// mgrin pa mgur chu brgyan pa'o// lha yi snying po'i sngags kyis ni// phreng ba brgya yi phyed kyis brgyan/ */ yi ge bdun pa'i gsang sngags kyis// gdub kor gyis ni rna ba brgyan// sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro mas// pags pa'i gos mchog 'dzin pa'o// rnal 'byor ma drug gsang sngags kyis// ska rags byas pa brgyan pa'o| |'khor lo kun gyi rnal 'byor ma'i// sngags ni btung ba'i thod pa'o// rnam snang mdzad ces sngags gang yin// thod pas dbu la brgyan pa'o// kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni lha yi sku// shes rab ḍā ma ru yi sgra// nyin mo bcom ldan 'das dpa' bo// rnal 'byor ma ni mtshan mo brjod// mya ngan 'das byung dpa' bo ni// drug pa'i sems kyi sprul pa ste// dag pa'i chos kyi sprul pa ni// phag mo'i gzugs su bstan pa yin// shrī yig gnyis med ye shes te// he zhes rgyu sogs stong pa nyid// ru yig bkod pa dang bral ba| |ka zhes gang du mi gnas pa'o// zhes pa'i don yab kyi rtsa sngags sogs ni tshangs skud sogs su dag la/

tshangs skud sogs ni yab kyi rtsa sngags sogs su dag go snyam pa phar dag tshur dag gnyis su shes par byas pa'i don sems so// de ltar gtso 'khor gzhal yas khang gi bar yang yang gsal btab la sgom pa ni shin tu rnal 'byor te bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// de la cung zad brtan par gyur nas/ bcu dgu pa ni/ bdag nyid he ru kar gsal ba'i sku'i nang du rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi gsal ba'i spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab kyi dbus su haṃ dkar po/ mgrin par oṃ dkar po/ snying gar hūm̐ nag po/ lte bar āḥdamar po/ āḥlas ye shes kyi me sbar ba las mas rim bzhin 'khor lo so so'i yi ge rnams bsregs shing*/ haṃ las byang chub kyi sems bab pas yas rim gyi yi ge rnams gsos pas bde drod khyad par can 'bar zhing nyams su myong bar bsam zhing*/ rlung kha sbyor du bsgoms pas du ba/ smig rgyu/ me khyer/ mar me/ sprin med kyi nam mkha' lta bu'i mtshan ma mngon du ma gyur bar 'bad do// de ltar bde chen nyams su myong ba rnal 'byor chen po ste rdzogs pa'i rim pa mdo tsam mo// nyi shu pa ni/ de ltar bsgoms pas skyo na bzlas pa la 'jug ste/ dung chen gyi phreng ba na rīs bkal ba'i ras kyi srad bu la brgyus pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i gdan la bgrang phreng ril bu re re bzhin hrīḥlas pad+ma gar dbang dmar po/ zhal gcig /phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis pad dmar dang ḍā ru/ g.yon gnyis dril bu dang thod pa/ gru mo g.yon du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga brten pa/ spyan gsum ral pa'i cod pan can/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag gi sham thabs dang phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis ye shes pa dang dbang lha spyan drangs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod do// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dam tshig pa la thim gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang lhar/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang lhas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag gyen du 'khyil ba las gsung rdo rjes dbu brgyan/ dbang lha de nyid la thim par gyur par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ dang nyer spyod rol mos mchod| oṃ pad+ma narte shwa ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ pad+ma gar dbang yongs su gyur pa las bgrang phreng gi rnam par gyur par bsam/ rang nyid he ru ka 'ja' tshon lta bu'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las sngags phreng 'od dang bcas pa dkar ser dmar ljang nag po sna tshogs pa spros/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud zhal nas thon pa yab kyi zhal du zhugs thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim par gyur par bsam/ yab kyi rtsa sngags sam phreng sngags dang*/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ swā hā/ snying po'o/ bdag med bstod 'grel las ni yi ge nyer gnyis pa rtsa ba'i sngags dang*/ oṃ haṃ hriṃ hrīṃ hūm̐ phaṭa ces pa ni snying po yi ge drug pa yin la/ yi ge bdun pa ni nye ba'i snying por gsungs 'dug pa gzhung btsun par bdog go// des na yi ge drug pa 'di'ang 'bum phrag lnga bzlas na gnad che ba 'dug go// oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ nye snying ngo*// oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ yum gyi snying po'o// oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ nye snying ngo*// 'khor gyi sngags bzla ba'i tshe/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi mthar bzla bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba hūm̐ las lha tshogs spros/ 'gro don byas slar lus hūm̐ la thim par gyur par mos pas/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ lā me huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rū pi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pa rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i'o// de ltar sngags bzla ba'i grangs sogs bshad tshod mang yang*/ don la grangs bsnyen ni phreng sngags la 'bum/ yab kyi snying po la 'bum phrag bzhi/ nye snying bye ba phrag gsum dang 'bum bzhi/ yum gyi snying po dang nye snying 'bum re/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi la khri phrag bzhi re bzla/ de yang grangs dus rtags gsum gsungs mod kyang don la grangs rtags gnyis gtso bor bzung ngo*// mthar bzlas pa'i bcu cha'i sbyin sreg kyang bya'o// nyer gcig pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis rten gzhal yas khang srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa mtha' nas rim gyis bsdus pa rnal 'byor ma bzhi la thim/ de yum la/ yum yab la/ yab thugs ka'i hūm̐ la/ de zhabs kyu/ khog pa/ mgo bo/ zla tshes/ thig le/ nā da'i bar du 'dus te/ nā da yang mi dmigs par gyur pa'i ngang du ci gnas mnyam par bzhag /ldang ba'i tshe/ slar yang rang nyid he ru ka rgyan med chu zla lta bur gyur/ shrī he ru ko3haṃ/ zhes der mos pa'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bar bya'o// nyer gnyis pa ni/ thun mtshams su 'jig rten las 'das pa dang 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma gnyis la nang mchod bran/ bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs nang mchod ltar byas la/ 'bar ba'i rgyas/ pheṃ/ gtor mgron dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor la gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra wī ṇi sogs rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ lha rnams kyi ljags 'od kyi rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gtor ma gsol bar gyur par bsam zhing*/ rdor thal kha phye bas/ oṃ badz+ra ā ral+li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul bas mnyes par mos la/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam par chags pa bcom zhing kun tu rtog pa 'joms// khyod kyis dngos po thams cad mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bdag nyid gzigs par ldan// mgon po thugs rje'i chu yi dpyid kyis brlan par gyur pa'i thugs kyi chus// bdag la mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyis shin tu rjes brtser mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/

slar yang 'bar ba'i rgyas/ pheṃ/ dur khrod brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong la sogs 'jig rten pa rnams skad cig gis bkug 'od gsal du bcug pa 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha'i rnam par gyur pa'i ljags 'od kyi rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol bas mnyes shing tshim par gyur par bsam/ rdor thal kha phye bas/ oṃ kha kha sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma bsngos pas 'byung po thams cad tshims par byas la/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes pa nas| yid la 'dod pa kun grub mdzod// kyi bar gyis phrin las bcol/ he ru ka'i yig brgyas lhag chad bskang*/ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs/ ye shes pa rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsams la gtor ma gnyis gtsang sar phul/ nyer gsum pa ni/ lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bar thun las ldang zhing spyod lam la 'jug /kha zas ni bdud rtsir dmigs nas longs spyad pas lus la lha rnams gdod nas grub pa mnyes par bsam/ nyal ba'i tshe snod bcud 'od gsal du bcug la nyal/ ldang ba'i tshe rnal 'byor ma'i glu'am ḍā ma ru'i sgras bskul bar bsams la ldang*/ khrus ni bum dbang ltar bya/ spyod lam kun thog mar g.yon pas spyad do// smras pa/ dpal ldan nam mkha' mnyam pa'i rgyud kyi dpyid// nā ro zhabs dang rdo rje mtshon cha'i gzhung*// rga lo'i man ngag dharma kīrti'i gsungs// ji bzhin cung zad rgyas la don dril ba// rang bzo spangs nas gzhan phan bsam pa yis// bris pa'i dge bas 'gro kun he ru ka'i// gong 'phang mchog la myur du gnas gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes lha lnga rga lo tsā ba gzhon du dpal gyi lugs gtso bor byas pa don gnyis kyi 'dod pa 'jo ba zhes bya ba/ dbur stod 'bri gung du skyu ra'i rigs las son pa rdo rje theg pa la mos pa dge ba can/ rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas shing khams gnyis skyes kyi lo khyu mchog zla ba dmar po'i mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshes la sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu sbyar ba'o//
//sarba maṅga laṃ shrī dz+wa la dzam+bu dwīpa a laṅkā ra ā gats+tsha//
